parts.watchFor: This chapter shows almost nothing on purpose. Watch the ground, and watch what is being written.

questions.q: What does the Quran say happens to the earth on the Day of Judgment?
options: It is leveled, pounded and crushed
It is split into seven seas
It turns to gold
It is swallowed by the sea

questions.q: What does the Quran compare people to on the Day of the Striking Calamity?
options: Scattered moths
Falling leaves
Rising smoke
Drifting sand

questions.q: How small a deed does 99:7-8 say will be seen?
options: Only the deeds that other people noticed
Only the deeds done in the last year
An atom's weight, of good or of evil
Only the deeds done in secret

questions.q: Who does 82:10-12 say is over you, keeping record?
options: Your family and your neighbours
Keepers, noble and recording, who know what you do
The angels of the throne, visible on the ground
Nobody; the record is kept in the earth itself

questions.q: What is the wrongdoer's wish, in 23:99-100?
options: To be forgiven without asking
To be sent back, to do righteousness in what he left behind
To be allowed to explain himself
To be given another lifetime

lesson.text: The Day of Judgment is described in pictures, not in a report: the earth leveled and crushed, the graves opened, people like scattered moths, the mountains like fluffed wool. Nothing of it is shown here, because what each person carried is known only to God.
lesson.curious: Two of the pictures are about how little it takes to matter: an atom's weight of good, or of evil. Another is about being recorded: keepers who know whatever you do. The last one is the hardest — that on that Day, no one can help anyone else, and the command is entirely with God.

carry.title: For the one whose scales are heavy

reflect.muslim: If the record is being written now, what would you want it to say about the last seven days?
reflect.curious: Who is keeping track of the things you do that nobody else notices? How does that make you feel?

parts.act: Do one small good thing today that no one will thank you for.
